title: Midjourney game concept gaining a lot of traction
author: Zinlencer

comments.author: Zinlencer
comments.body:
Saw this one on X. If you had to make this concept a reality how would you go about it?

I think the generated style looks very interesting. It's not a typical perspective camera. But it looks like multiple layers of large billboards (kind of like a shoebox diorama)
